build_mlp_mnist_training: build a functional MLP neural network to train on MNIST using Sonnet's functional API
create_loss_function: create a loss function that computes sparse softmax cross entropy over MLP logits
run_training_loop: run a JIT-compiled training loop with Adam optimizer over 10 epochs on MNIST
